correctness.rationale: Writing \(J=1-L\), \(D_1=0\) gives \(D-E=J^2/3\), hence \(p'(u)=3(u-J/3)^2\). Substitution into the source discriminant expression gives \(\Delta_2=(J^3+27(N-A))^2\), so \(\Delta_2<0\) is impossible and \(\Delta_2=0\) is equivalent to \(N-A=-J^3/27\). Then \(p(u)=(u-J/3)^3\), with positive root because \(J>0\). I independently reproduced all three symbolic identities from the coefficients; the inspected verifier checks the same algebra and confirms that \(Q\) is absent from \(p\) and \(p'\).

final_claim: For the Case-3 equilibrium cubic \(p(u)=u^3+(L-1)u^2+(D-E)u+(N-A)\), under \(N-A<0\), \(L<1\), and \(D-E>0\), a positive triple root occurs exactly when \(D_1=0\) and \(\Delta_2=0\), equivalently \(D-E=(1-L)^2/3\) and \(N-A=-(1-L)^3/27\).
